unit: X1 and the measuring half of X3 of docs/plans/SELF_PROOF_EXECUTION_PLAN_2026-11-12.md
claim: measurement only. A BYTE_EQUAL row says one program printed pinned Lean's bytes through that lane. It is not a codegen license, covers no other program, and makes no item of the plan's section 2.1 hold.
how_to_read: `programs` pins what each lane does with each fixture program, and for the R4 probes what `clean check` (Clean's elaborator and kernel, no backend) does; the test fails when a live outcome differs. A lane outcome is BYTE_EQUAL, a refusal by name (REFUSED_BUILD, REFUSED_RUNTIME, EMIT_TRUSTIR_REFUSED, TRUSTCG_REFUSED, LINK_FAILED) or CRASHED (the process died on a signal after printing a prefix of Lean's bytes; a crash is not a refusal and is pinned only so its gap is listed). `gaps` is the burn-down list: one row per construct a lane refuses or crashes on, with the refusing source site. `lane_shortfalls` lists what the trust-cg lane does not give even where it prints the right bytes. `r4_items` maps the ten items of risk R4 of designs/2026-11-12-kcheck-model-first.md to their probes. `rejected_by_lean` pins `clean check` on programs pinned Lean rejects (the negative controls), and `false_acceptances` owns each of those Clean accepts. `closed_in_this_unit` records what was refused when the unit began and is not any more. A refusal that closes fails the test; retire its gap and re-pin the row in the same change.

closed_gaps.construct: a self tail call on Nat compiled as recursive closure applications rather than a loop, overflowing the compiled program stack
closed_gaps.was: c27 (10^6 steps), c37_head_loop_100000 (10^5), c33 and c36 died of SIGSEGV on both lanes at the default 8 MiB stack. Structural recursion with a function-typed motive was compiled to a closure per step: `go(pred)` returned a closure that the caller applied with `clean_apply_n`, the induction hypothesis was bound eagerly at the head of the arm, and a lifted mutual block built its `PProd` tuple of closures eagerly. No recursive call was a direct call in tail position (464 B of C stack per step measured with lldb).
closed_gaps.fix: X4 (reports/x4-head-loop-2026-11-15/README.md). An induction hypothesis is a call of the synthesized recursive function where it occurs, uncurried by the minors' syntactic arity (crates/clean-compiler/src/to_lcnf/rec_ih.rs); a lifted mutual block becomes one function with a selector (rec_select.rs); a syntactic well-founded step is inlined the same way (rec_wf.rs); an over-applied case analysis passing an IH is commuted into its alternatives (rec_commute.rs). On the final L5IR every self tail call becomes a jump to a loop join point (tail_loop.rs): `goto` in C, a branch in trust-ir, with parallel jump assignment (emit_c/body.rs, emit_rust/body.rs), erased jump arguments materialised (emit_trust_ir.rs), a back-edge model in the RC linearity check (rc_repair_linearity_back_edge.rs) and no CSE of actions (opt/cse/mod.rs).
closed_gaps.tests: crates/clean/tests/deep_recursion.rs (both lanes, opt 0/1/2, a 512 KiB stack, Lean bytes, with the non-tail negative control and emitted-shape pins); crates/clean-compiler/src/tail_loop_tests.rs, to_lcnf/rec_ih_tests.rs, to_lcnf/rec_select_tests.rs, to_lcnf/rec_wf_tests.rs, opt/cse/action_tests.rs
closed_gaps.probe: c27, c33, c36, c37_head_loop_100000 and the new c37_head_loop_10000000: BYTE_EQUAL on both lanes at the default 8 MiB stack; head_loop_samples now has a 10^7 row
closed_gaps.scope: self tail calls of one synthesized recursive function (a member of a lifted mutual block counts, through its selector). As in Lean, a tail call between separate functions is not a loop, and a non-tail recursion still uses the stack (deep_recursion's non_tail_deep_1m control). The entry still runs on the process's main thread (R3, Lean's 1 GiB entry thread, is not in this unit).
